text:
Eve (product): Quick idea: add a compact 'Invocation Row' to the Cost Dashboard that surfaces per-invocation token split, model_variant, slab_id (if any), amortized cache credit, and a 'simulate no-cache' delta. Need agreement on telemetry + API before design locks mocks.
Marco (eng): Sounds useful. Two constraints: keep the default row lightweight (<1KB) and avoid joining heavy time-series on the fly. Suggest summary pre-agg + sampled trace expand.
Dan (platform): Telemetry gaps: router doesn't currently emit slab_id or chosen_variant for fallback chains. We should add optional fields slab_id (only when prefetch used) and chosen_variant to the telemetry proto.
Leah (design): UI plan: compact stacked microbar (prompt/completion/cached), small badge with amortized credit, and a popover that lazy-loads the full trace when the user clicks. Show a sampled/confidence indicator.
econ-bot: FYI: full-trace sampling at 0.5% today. Increasing to 1% will materially increase storage and trace query p95. Pre-agg approach recommended for tile-level queries.
Eve (product): Proposed endpoint: GET /v1/costs/invocations?start=...&end=...&expand=trace,slab&sample_pct=0.5. Default returns pre-agg summary rows; expand=trace fetches sampled raw trace.
Marco (eng): Backend approach: maintain hourly pre-agg table keyed by slab_id with avoided_tokens and cost_rate. Summary endpoint joins to pre-agg to compute cache_credit_usd; expand hits sampled trace store. Also add quota/cost for expand=trace.
Dan (platform): I'll draft the telemetry RFC to add slab_id and chosen_variant (rollout behind flag). Will include migration plan: emit slab_id only for requests that touch prefetch to limit cardinality.
Leah (design): I'll mock the row + popover and include a confidence chip and formula hover text for amortization.
Eve (product): Action items: Dan RFC (48h), Marco prototype pre-agg SQL (1w), Leah mock + copy (3d), Eve endpoint spec + rate-limit proposal (3d). Thanks all.
Marco (eng): Note: recommend 5min pre-agg for hot slabs and hourly for cold to keep tile snappy.
Eve (product): Great — aiming for alpha with 0.5% sampled traces + pre-agg tile in 2 sprints. I'll post links here when ready. :rocket:
